prompt: You are evaluating a ticket classifier that must output one of five fixed labels. Which grading method does Anthropic suggest first?

options.text: LLM-based grading with a free-form rubric.
Code-based grading such as exact match, which is fastest, most reliable and extremely scalable.

explanation: Pick the fastest, most reliable, most scalable method. Code-based grading (exact or string match) suits categorical answers but lacks nuance; LLM-based grading is flexible but needs reliability testing; human grading is highest quality but slow and expensive.

sources.title: Define success criteria and build evaluations (Claude Docs)
